description: Each case gives a test output and checks that the skill picks the expected category, verdict and next owner.

evals.name: product-bug-health
evals.prompt: Triage the test output in evals/cases/product-bug.txt for task T012. The spec (AC2) says GET /health returns 200 with {"status": "ok"}.
evals.expected_output: One bug classified PRODUCT_BUG, verdict NOT READY, next owner developer, location in product code, protected guarantee /health marked FAIL.
assertions: Bug has Repro, Expected, Actual and Location fields
Does not edit any product or test file

evals.name: env-issue-docker
evals.prompt: Triage the test output in evals/cases/env-issue.txt for task T013.
evals.expected_output: Classified ENV_ISSUE, verdict NOT READY, next owner orchestrator. Not blamed on the code.

evals.name: ambiguous-spec
evals.prompt: Triage the test output in evals/cases/spec-unclear.txt for task T014. The spec only says 'risk score is returned'. It does not give a range.
evals.expected_output: Classified SPEC_UNCLEAR (not TEST_BUG), listed in Open questions, next owner orchestrator.
assertions: Does not classify it as TEST_BUG
Adds an entry to Open questions

evals.name: all-pass
evals.prompt: Triage the test output in evals/cases/all-pass.txt for task T015.
evals.expected_output: Verdict READY, Bugs: none, next owner orchestrator; /health SKIPPED with reason because --fast was used.
assertions: stack /health is SKIPPED with a reason, not PASS
